recognize_zh: G 顯帶核型圖中，第 5、7、16、17 號染色體各只剩一條（箭頭），另有數條無法辨認的標記染色體（markers），屬於複雜核型（complex karyotype），其中 -5、-7 為定義 AML-MRC 的細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyogram arranged by chromosome pair with a separate row for marker chromosomes
Single copies (monosomy or structural loss) of chromosomes 5, 7, 16 and 17, indicated by arrows
Several unidentifiable marker chromosomes shown at lower right
Sex chromosomes shown as one larger and one smaller chromosome, consistent with XY
Low banding resolution and fuzzy chromosome morphology typical of malignant marrow metaphases
describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram from a bone marrow metaphase. It shows loss of one homolog of chromosomes 5, 7, 16 and 17 (arrows) together with multiple unidentified marker chromosomes, which likely carry the missing material in rearranged form; sex chromosomes appear to be XY. Band resolution is low, so structural rearrangements cannot be characterized further from this image. The findings represent a complex karyotype (three or more abnormalities) including -5/5q and -7/7q abnormalities, which are myelodysplasia-related cytogenetic abnormalities and support classification as acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes; loss of 17p is frequently associated with TP53 mutation and adverse prognosis.
